integrity: The strict inequalities come from an exact bounded-complete memory representation and stationary generator identities. Finite numerical experiments are not used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns compact invariant sets and compactly supported invariant probability measures of the classical ODE; it does not establish existence of an attractor, chaos, or hyperchaos.
The theorem gives no parameter-only quantitative lower bound for \(v\) on a compact invariant set.
The statement does not apply directly to transient finite-time trajectories or to a DSP discretization viewed as a different dynamical system.
title: A positive memory half-space and exact stationary transfer law for a six-dimensional memristor flow
